text: The customer received a speaker with a cracked cover (Order LM-48870) and initially requested a refund. The agent mistakenly approved a full refund of ₹3,499 before retracting it due to the return policy on opened items, and instead offered a free replacement cover. Next, the free replacement cover needs to be sent to the customer, who accepted the offer but remains upset about the mix-up.
